title: Native CLM v0 M2-R0 — Protected Update Invariant Audit
scientific_question: Does the actual Cell parameter update produced by the canonical M2 protected optimizer satisfy the registered certificate nullspace invariant dW Q^T ~= 0, and if not, which optimizer transformation breaks it?

later_failure_decomposition_evidence.interpretation: Later routing/growth diagnostics do not replace M2. They motivate returning to the fixed-topology write primitive.

data.role: optimizer-mechanics gradient source only; no retention or continual-learning decision

current_adamw_grad_projection.role: exact canonical M2 protected optimizer mechanics

adamw_no_decay_grad_projection.role: isolates Adam elementwise preconditioning with weight decay removed

sgd_no_decay_grad_projection.role: algebraic reference where projected gradient equals actual update direction

sgd_with_decay_grad_projection.role: isolates the weight-decay transaction from adaptive preconditioning

adamw_final_update_projection.role: candidate mechanics repair: project the complete realized AdamW parameter delta, including preconditioning and decay

classification_rule: First require sufficient nonzero-update coverage and require both SGD-no-decay and AdamW-final-update-projection references to satisfy the reference max/p95 thresholds. If either reference fails, INCONCLUSIVE_REFERENCE_FAILURE. If canonical AdamW does not materially violate, CURRENT_UPDATE_INVARIANT_HOLDS. Otherwise classify adaptive preconditioning from AdamW-no-decay and weight decay from SGD-with-decay: both bad -> BOTH_PRECONDITIONER_AND_WEIGHT_DECAY_BREAK_UPDATE_INVARIANT; only AdamW-no-decay bad -> ADAMW_PRECONDITIONER_BREAKS_UPDATE_INVARIANT; only SGD-with-decay bad -> WEIGHT_DECAY_BREAKS_UPDATE_INVARIANT; if canonical is bad while neither isolated arm is materially bad -> MIXED_OR_INTERACTION_UPDATE_INVARIANT_VIOLATION.
explicit_nonclaims: that repairing the optimizer update invariant is sufficient for continual learning
that the M1 certificate covers the full old-language functional manifold
that growth is necessary or unnecessary
that any M2 formal decision is retroactively changed

roadmap.M2_R0: audit and repair actual update invariance before changing certificate semantics
roadmap.M2_R1: reconstruct fixed-final-M1 certificates and compare all-active activation SVD / importance-weighted / functional Jacobian-Fisher sketches against held-out old-function drift
roadmap.M2_R2: with frozen router and 8 Cells, rerun replay-free B->C->D continual language using the selected certificate and constrained update mechanism on untouched formal seeds; only a passing end-to-end retention/plasticity result can reopen growth work
